Subject: Supplier setup question — VAT handling for Portugal entity

Hi Karthik,

We're working through the supplier onboarding for Novus Logistics (Portugal branch) and hit a couple of questions about how Redwood wants VAT evidence and PO entity mapping for EU suppliers. Our AP team needs to know:

- Which legal entity should appear on the PO when we request payment?
- Do you accept a Portuguese VAT certificate (Certidão de Registo de IVA) as sufficient proof for reverse charge/exemption?
- Any specific invoice fields required (VAT number format, fiscal representative details)?

I can attach the VAT certificate and our completed onboarding form if that helps. We're aiming to get the first PO issued by the end of the month.

Thanks,
Maria Velasquez
Senior Finance Manager
Novus Logistics
attachments: Novus_VAT_Certificate.pdf
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: Maria Velasquez <maria.velasquez@novuslogistics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier setup question — VAT handling for Portugal entity

Maria — thanks for the note and the PDF. Short answers up front, then a few steps to get you across the finish line.

1) PO entity: For services we route POs to Redwood EU Services S.R.L. (our Portuguese purchasing entity) by default. If Novus prefers billing to a different Redwood legal entity, flag it now and we can validate tax implications.

2) VAT evidence: A Portuguese VAT certificate is acceptable evidence for VAT registration. We require a copy of the certificate and a supplier onboarding form that includes the VAT number in the standardized EU format (PTXXXXXXXX).

3) Invoice fields: On the invoice please include: supplier VAT number (PT...), legal name and address of your Portugal entity, invoice currency, invoice date, and a clear line referencing the PO number we issue. If you rely on a fiscal representative, please include their name and fiscal rep reference on the invoice.

Next steps (quick checklist):
- Please fill and return our onboarding spreadsheet (linked).
- Attach the VAT certificate and a bank details sheet.
- Confirm which Redwood entity you want the PO issued to (default: Redwood EU Services S.R.L.).

I've attached a blank supplier onboarding template and a short PO mapping guide. Laura — can procurement confirm SLA on turnaround for PO issuance after we receive completed docs? Ben — can you confirm if we need any additional legal attestation for reverse charge on services into PT?

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Manager, Global Procurement
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Maria — procurement can complete PO issuance within 48 business hours once we have: completed onboarding form, VAT certificate, and bank details. A couple of operational notes:

- PO legal entity: we will default to Redwood EU Services S.R.L. unless Novus elects another entity (we will need a formal confirmation in writing).
- PO content: please include the contact person for remittance and the email for AP (accounts@novuslogistics.com) so the PO gets routed to the correct inbox.
- Payment terms: standard 30 days net unless there are negotiated terms on the contract.

Ben — if legal/tax needs anything extra (e.g., signed declaration), let us know and we can pause issuance. Maria — once you return the form I will create the PO and copy AP.

Best,
